name: Pantolactone
description: Pantolactone (CAS 79-50-5 ), also supplied as DL-Pantolactone, is a cyclic lactone intermediate used across pharmaceutical synthesis, cosmetic formulation, and food processing. It functions primarily as a chiral building block and stabilizing agent. This chemical is essential in the production of pantothenic acid (Vitamin B5) and related compounds. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it serves as a key precursor in the synthesis of pantothenic acid and coenzyme A derivatives. Controlled stereochemistry drives sourcing decisions for this material in medical applications. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into skin care products for its moisture-retention properties, supporting hydration in serums and creams. It is also utilized in hair conditioning treatments to improve texture and health. In food and flavor applications, it contributes stabilizing functionality to nutrient premixes and various fortified products. Research and fine chemical producers source it as a resolved or racemic chiral synthon for asymmetric synthesis programs. The material is available as a white crystalline powder or solid for industrial use. It is supplied in both racemic (DL) and optically active forms to meet specific needs. Purity grades range from technical to high-purity pharmaceutical-grade material, often meeting USP or FCC standards. Packaging typically ranges from kilogram quantities to bulk drums, depending on application requirements.
